name: litestack
description: LiteStack meta-repo — coordination layer over the backend/frontend submodules. Holds no app code; owns cross-project tooling (LikeC4 diagrams, scripts).

scripts.likec4:validate: out=$(likec4 validate docs/architecture/likec4 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }; echo "$out"; case "$out" in *"(0 files)"*) echo "likec4: no files were parsed - the model path is wrong or the model is gone" >&2; exit 1;; esac
scripts.scale:validate: if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f scale/docker-compose.yml config -q; else echo 'docker not installed — skipping compose check'; fi && if command -v caddy >/dev/null 2>&1; then caddy validate --config scale/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile; elif command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker run --rm -v "$PWD/scale/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro" caddy:2-alpine caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile; else echo 'neither caddy nor docker — skipping Caddyfile check'; fi
